name: velox-trifit
description: Integrate Velox DressMe virtual try-on with tested SDK examples and offline mocks.

interface.longDescription: Integrate Velox DressMe virtual clothing try-on into an app, website or retail backend. Includes the public Node.js SDK, TypeScript declarations, runnable offline mocks and safe upload/job/polling guidance. Live API use requires a manually approved partner configuration; pricing and allowances are agreed with Velox. No API key is required for installation or offline tests.
defaultPrompt: Use Velox TriFit API to build a Node.js virtual try-on backend and test it with the offline mock.
Explain how to add Velox DressMe to my TypeScript website without exposing my API key.
Explain the partner application process and the available SDKs.
